option_relations.rationale: Lymphangioma does not match the histologic and clinical findings described in the vignette.
Papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma (Dabska tumor) matches the clinical and histologic description provided.
Benign lymphangioendothelioma (BLAE) is consistent with some of the histologic features, but the clinical presentation and other findings are more closely aligned with another option.
Pseudo-Kaposi’s sarcoma (acroangiodermatitis) does not match the specific histologic and clinical characteristics described.
